row.proto: void Ne_RobinHoodSet_Rehash_U64KeyPtr(void *set, uint64_t new_bucket_count, uint8_t free_old_storage)
row.notes: (lib) Rehash for the u64-keyed pointer set: allocs new_bucket_count plus overflow slots (9 bytes each + 8), reinserts every live pointer by key at elem+8, then either frees the old storage or (flag 0 and block >= 0x48 bytes) recycles it as 0x40-byte nodes onto the pool free list at set+8/+0x10.
